jobs.reference: Hello. My name is Ava. We meet our English group at six. There are four students in this group. What is your name? My name is Tom. I am a new student too. Three textbooks are on that table. Two notebooks are on this table. The teacher has a marker. Please sit here, Tom. This is my notebook. Is that your textbook? We can open our books and write our names. I can show you my note. Yes, this is my textbook. I have a question. I do not understand one sound. Can you speak again, please? I want to check the sound before I read.

Yes. Listen to the sound. I can help you spell the name. The name is Ben. It has three letters. We can say the letters together. Thank you, Ava. I can spell Ben now. I write the name in my notebook. I ask the teacher to check my work. Yes. The teacher can help us. We have ten minutes for a short task. Please read the note and then stand near the group. We can speak to the other students. The teacher shows us the next part. We can listen together. It is fine to ask for help. Thank you. I have five names on my note, but I read only one name first. Then we can ask the teacher another question.

Hello, Cal. On class days, I wake at five. I get up and wash my face. My room is cool. What time do you wake? I wake at six. I put on a shirt. I put a sock on each foot. My shoe is under the bed. I find it and put it on. I have a blue shirt today. I also have a dress, but I choose the shirt. The sun is out, so I put a hat on my head before I leave. I take a quick look at my note. I start class at ten. Do you start at ten too? We can meet our group at the table.

Yes. I start at ten. I eat lunch at one and finish class at three. After class, I stay in the room for five minutes. I check a note for the teacher. I finish at three too. Then I leave with you. I take a slow walk to the shop. A short walk helps my body feel ready for the next part of the day. I lift my hand to wave to a friend. I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write my class time for tomorrow. I plan to wear my dress tomorrow. That is a good plan. I check my hair before dinner. I do not need the same plan as you. We can each choose our own times.
